item.description: Unfolding crisis shows importance of ‘human connections’ over the long term – especially in under-vaccinated areas Tristan Sharratt, a family nurse practitioner and public health researcher, began serving an Amish community in central New York almost inadvertently. Word spread quickly, and now Sharratt sees many members of the community, which numbers in the hundreds. He is what is called a “trusted messenger” – someone who understands a community and has earned their respect.
